title: Psalm 138: Thanks Before the Gods
summary: David gives thanks to the LORD with his whole heart, bowing toward the holy temple because God answered him on the day he called and gave him strength. He foresees all the kings of the earth praising the LORD when they hear his words, and he rests in the truth that the LORD, though high, regards the lowly. He closes confident that God will fulfill his purpose for him and asks him not to abandon the work of his hands.

from.text: Psalm 138 is an individual song of thanksgiving

line: David thanks the LORD with his whole heart because God answered on the day he called and strengthened him, and trusts God to fulfill his purpose for him.
guide: Sometimes God's answer is not to remove the trouble but to give courage inside it. On a hard day, borrow verse 8; when you are unsure of it, pray its last line: you are his work.

stanzas.title: The kings of the earth praise the LORD who regards the lowly
Confidence in trouble: the LORD will fulfill his purpose

verses.t: Of David. I give You thanks with all my heart; before the gods I sing Your praises.
I bow down toward Your holy temple and give thanks to Your name for Your loving devotion and Your faithfulness; You have exalted Your name and Your word above all else.
On the day I called, You answered me; You emboldened me and strengthened my soul.
All the kings of the earth will give You thanks, O LORD, when they hear the words of Your mouth.
They will sing of the ways of the LORD, for the glory of the LORD is great.
Though the LORD is on high, He attends to the lowly; but the proud He knows from afar.
If I walk in the midst of trouble, You preserve me from the anger of my foes; You extend Your hand, and Your right hand saves me.
The LORD will fulfill His purpose for me. O LORD, Your loving devotion endures forever— do not abandon the works of Your hands.
